integrity_note: chain_head is a SHA-256 hash chain over this program's ledger. It detects uncoordinated edits within an intact ledger; it is not a digital signature and does not prove the ledger was never rewritten as a whole. It is unsigned and not externally anchored; no chain head is published by Mirage.

narrative: The Deflated Sharpe confidence is 1.00: the best Sharpe exceeds the expected best-of-12 luck threshold. This is a model-based exceedance estimate, not the probability that genuine skill exists.
The in-sample winner stayed above the OOS median in 77% of splits.
There is insufficient evidence that the best trial outperforms the benchmark after data snooping (Reality Check p = 0.59); this does not prove the absence of an edge.
Score cleared the Survives bar, but the Reality Check finds insufficient evidence of outperformance versus the benchmark - label capped at Unclear.
